text: Dopolnite pregovor: „Rana ura, … ura.“
gloss: Complete the proverb: "An early hour, a ... hour." — Golden: "Rana ura, zlata ura" (the early bird catches the worm).

text: Katera beseda, prebrana od zadaj naprej, postane ime pijače?
gloss: Which word, read backwards, becomes the name of a drink? — Kos (piece/blackbird) → sok (juice). Every option reverses into a real word (kar, kol, kot), so the player must check the meaning.

text: Če je pojutrišnjem sobota, kateri dan je bil včeraj?
gloss: If the day after tomorrow is Saturday, what day was yesterday? — Wednesday: tomorrow is Friday, today Thursday (the trap), yesterday Wednesday.

text: V katerem morju je voda tako slana, da kopalec v njem obleži na gladini kot zamašek?
gloss: In which sea is the water so salty that a bather floats like a cork? — The Dead Sea. All options are 'colour/adjective' seas.

text: Kako se imenuje praznično pecivo iz kvašenega testa, ki ga namažemo z orehovim nadevom in zvijemo?
gloss: What is the festive yeast pastry spread with walnut filling and rolled up? — Potica. Gibanica is layered, šarkelj is a raisin bundt, kremšnita a cream slice.

text: Kateri plin rastline jemljejo iz zraka, da lahko ob sončni svetlobi tvorijo hrano?
gloss: Which gas do plants take from the air to make food in sunlight? — Carbon dioxide (photosynthesis); oxygen is the tempting product.

text: Katera ptica svojih jajc ne vali sama, ampak jih podtakne v gnezda drugih ptic?
gloss: Which bird doesn't hatch its own eggs but slips them into other birds' nests? — The cuckoo (hence the idiom 'kukavičje jajce').

text: V Planici so leta 1994 prvič na svetu preleteli 200 metrov. V katerem športu?
gloss: In Planica in 1994, 200 metres were flown for the first time in the world. In which sport? — Ski jumping (Toni Nieminen, 203 m, March 1994).

text: Kako je ime zabavnemu snežaku v risanki Ledeno kraljestvo?
gloss: What is the funny snowman called in Frozen? — Olaf. Sven is the reindeer, Kristoff and Hans are the human leads.

text: Na god katerega svetnika po ljudskem izročilu mošt postane vino?
gloss: On whose saint's day, by folk tradition, does must turn into wine? — St Martin (Martinovo, 11 November).

text: Kdo je napisal zgodbo o silaku Martinu Krpanu, ki na Dunaju premaga strašnega Brdavsa?
gloss: Who wrote the story of strongman Martin Krpan, who defeats the terrible Brdavs in Vienna? — Fran Levstik (1858). The others are 19th/early-20th-century prose writers.

text: Kdo je leta 1550 izdal Katekizem in Abecednik, prvi slovenski tiskani knjigi?
gloss: Who published the Catechism and the Primer in 1550, the first two printed Slovene books? — Primož Trubar. Bohorič and Dalmatin were his Protestant contemporaries.

text: Koliko nog imajo skupaj pajek, mravlja in kokoš?
gloss: How many legs do a spider, an ant and a hen have together? — 16: 8 + 6 + 2. Common facts plus a sum; 14 catches those who give the spider six.

text: Slovenska abeceda nima črk q, w, x in y, ki jih pozna angleška, ima pa č, š in ž. Koliko črk ima?
gloss: The Slovene alphabet lacks q, w, x, y, which English has, but has č, š, ž. How many letters? — 25: English 26 − 4 + 3.

text: Katera reka teče skozi deset držav, več kot katera koli druga v Evropi?
gloss: Which river flows through ten countries, more than any other in Europe? — The Danube (Germany to Ukraine).

text: Hlod razžagaš na pet enakih kosov. Vsak rez traja dve minuti. Koliko minut žagaš?
gloss: You saw a log into five equal pieces; each cut takes two minutes. How many minutes? — 8: five pieces need only four cuts. 10 is the autopilot trap.

text: Kateri arhitekt je Ljubljani podaril Tromostovje, Narodno in univerzitetno knjižnico ter tržnice ob Ljubljanici?
gloss: Which architect gave Ljubljana the Triple Bridge, the National and University Library and the riverside market halls? — Jože Plečnik. The others are major Ljubljana architects too.

text: Pri katerem glasbilu pritisk na tipko sproži kladivce, ki udari ob struno?
gloss: In which instrument does pressing a key make a hammer strike a string? — The piano. The harpsichord (the trap) plucks its strings.

text: Kupiš nekaj za 3,40 € in plačaš s petakom. Prodajalka ti vrne drobiž s čim manj kovanci. Koliko kovancev dobiš?
gloss: You buy something for €3.40 and pay with a €5 note; the change comes in as few coins as possible. How many? — 3: €1.60 = €1 + 50 c + 10 c.

text: Pod katero goro po najbolj znani pripovedki spi kralj Matjaž s svojo vojsko?
gloss: Under which mountain, in the best-known legend, does King Matjaž sleep with his army? — Under Peca, in Koroška.

text: Ajdovi žganci so slovenska klasika, a ajda botanično sploh ni žito. S katero rastlino je v sorodu?
gloss: Buckwheat žganci are a Slovene classic, yet buckwheat is not a cereal. Which plant is it related to? — Rhubarb: both are in the knotweed family (Polygonaceae). Millet is a true cereal.

text: Nogometno moštvo dobi za zmago 3 točke, za neodločen izid 1. Po petih tekmah brez poraza ima 7 točk. Kolikokrat je zmagalo?
gloss: 3 points for a win, 1 for a draw. After five unbeaten matches a team has 7 points. How many wins? — Once: 1 win + 4 draws = 7; two wins would give at least 9.

text: Kateri od teh dogodkov se je zgodil najpozneje?
options: Magellanov odhod na plovbo okoli sveta
gloss: Which of these events happened last? — Shakespeare's birth (1564). Columbus 1492, Luther's theses 1517, Magellan set out 1519.

text: Rečemo „dve mizi“ in „pet miz“. Kako pravilno rečemo, če je miz 102?
gloss: We say 'two tables' (dual) and 'five tables' (genitive plural). How do we say 102 tables? — 'Sto dve mizi': in compound numbers the noun follows the last numeral, so 102 takes the dual. 'Sto dve mize' is the common slip.

text: Zvok v zraku prepotuje približno 340 metrov v sekundi. Blisk vidiš, grom zaslišiš šest sekund pozneje. Kako daleč je udarila strela?
gloss: Sound travels about 340 m/s; the thunder comes six seconds after the flash. How far away was the lightning? — About 2 km (340 × 6 ≈ 2040 m).

text: Katera južnoameriška država nima morja, ima pa vojno mornarico, ki pluje po jezeru Titicaca?
gloss: Which South American country has no sea but has a navy on Lake Titicaca? — Bolivia. Paraguay is landlocked but not on Titicaca; Peru shares the lake but has a coast.

text: Kateri režiser je posnel Žrelo in Jurski park?
gloss: Which director made Jaws and Jurassic Park? — Steven Spielberg. Lucas, his close friend, is the trap.

text: Kateri slovenski impresionist je naslikal Sejalca, ki je postal eden od simbolov slovenstva?
gloss: Which Slovene impressionist painted The Sower, which became a symbol of Slovene identity? — Ivan Grohar (1907). The other three are the rest of the impressionist group.

text: Katero računalniško igro s padajočimi kockami je leta 1984 v Moskvi ustvaril Aleksej Pažitnov?
gloss: Which computer game with falling blocks did Alexey Pajitnov create in Moscow in 1984? — Tetris.

text: Slovenci rečemo „petindvajset“: najprej enice, nato desetice. Kateri od teh jezikov šteje na enak način?
gloss: Slovenes say 'five-and-twenty': units first, then tens. Which of these languages counts the same way? — German (fünfundzwanzig). English twenty-five, Italian venticinque, Croatian dvadeset pet put the tens first.

text: V dvojiškem sistemu, ki ga uporabljajo računalniki, sta le števki 0 in 1. Katero število je dvojiško zapisano kot 101?
gloss: In binary, used by computers, there are only the digits 0 and 1. Which number is written 101 in binary? — 5: 4 + 0 + 1.

text: Knežji kamen, ki je upodobljen na slovenskem kovancu za 2 centa, danes hranijo v katerem mestu?
gloss: The Prince's Stone, shown on the Slovene 2-cent coin, is kept today in which city? — Klagenfurt (Celovec), in Carinthia, Austria.

text: Koga želi Cankarjev hlapec Jernej najti, ko se peš odpravi na Dunaj iskat svojo pravico?
gloss: Whom does Cankar's farmhand Jernej want to find when he walks to Vienna in search of his justice? — The emperor.

text: Kemijski simbol Pb izhaja iz latinskega imena kovine, iz katerega se je razvila tudi naša beseda „plomba“. Za katero kovino gre?
gloss: The symbol Pb comes from the metal's Latin name, which also gave Slovene the word 'plomba' (a seal/filling). Which metal? — Lead (plumbum); seals were once made of lead.

text: Na katerem orodju je Miroslav Cerar dvakrat postal olimpijski prvak?
gloss: On which apparatus did Miroslav Cerar twice become Olympic champion? — Pommel horse (Tokyo 1964, Mexico City 1968).

text: Katera od teh prestolnic leži najbolj zahodno?
gloss: Which of these capitals lies furthest west? — Prague (about 14.42° E), slightly west of Ljubljana (about 14.51° E). Most players assume Ljubljana.

text: Renesančnega skladatelja s Kranjske, ki mu Slovenci pravimo Jakob Petelin, je Evropa poznala pod latinskim imenom. Katerim?
gloss: The Renaissance composer from Carniola whom Slovenes call Jakob Petelin was known in Europe by a Latin name. Which? — Jacobus Gallus: gallus is Latin for rooster (petelin). The others are real Latinised names of Lasso, Clemens and Josquin.

text: Po pripovedki o Zlatorogu je iz krvi ranjenega belega gamsa zrasla čudežna rožica. Katera?
gloss: In the Zlatorog legend, a magic flower grew from the wounded white chamois's blood. Which? — The Triglav rose (triglavska roža), which healed him. Edelweiss (planika) is the trap.

text: Kateri italijanski sir nosi ime po živali, iz katere mleka ga izdelujejo?
gloss: Which Italian cheese is named after the animal whose milk it is made from? — Pecorino, from pecora, 'sheep'. Parmesan and gorgonzola are named after places.

text: Beseda „robot“ izhaja iz igre Karla Čapka R.U.R. Kaj je pomenila češka beseda, iz katere je nastala?
gloss: The word 'robot' comes from Karel Čapek's play R.U.R. What did the Czech word it came from mean? — Corvée, forced labour (robota; Slovene 'tlaka').

text: Kateri del človeškega telesa nima krvnih žil, zato večino kisika dobi kar iz zraka?
gloss: Which part of the human body has no blood vessels and so takes most of its oxygen straight from the air? — The cornea. The lens is also avascular but sits inside the eye and is fed by the aqueous humour.

text: Rimljani so Ljubljani rekli Emona, Ptuju pa Poetovio. Katero današnje slovensko mesto je bilo rimski Nauportus?
gloss: The Romans called Ljubljana Emona and Ptuj Poetovio. Which Slovene town was Roman Nauportus? — Vrhnika. Celje was Celeia.

text: Robbov vodnjak pred ljubljanskim rotovžem se zgleduje po Berninijevem Vodnjaku štirih rek v Rimu. Katere reke predstavljajo njegovi kipi?
gloss: Robba's fountain by Ljubljana town hall is modelled on Bernini's Four Rivers fountain in Rome. Which rivers do its statues represent? — The Sava, Krka and Ljubljanica, the three Carniolan rivers.

text: Kako je ime konju, na katerem Don Kihot jezdi v boj z mlini na veter?
gloss: What is the name of the horse Don Quixote rides against the windmills? — Rocinante (Slovene: Rosinante). Bucephalus was Alexander's, Marengo Napoleon's, Pegasus mythical.

text: Katero morje je edino na svetu, ki nima nobene obale, saj ga obdajajo samo morski tokovi?
gloss: Which is the only sea with no coast at all, bounded only by ocean currents? — The Sargasso Sea.

text: Kaj pri golfu pomeni albatros?
gloss: What is an albatross in golf? — Three strokes under par (birdie one, eagle two, condor four).

text: Začetnice verzov magistrala v Prešernovem Sonetnem vencu tvorijo napis PRIMICOVI JULJI. Koliko sonetov ima ves venec?
gloss: The first letters of the lines of the master sonnet in Prešeren's Wreath of Sonnets spell PRIMICOVI JULJI. How many sonnets in the whole wreath? — 15: the acrostic has 14 letters, one per line of the master sonnet, and each line opens one of 14 sonnets; plus the master sonnet itself.

text: Na Ljubljanskem barju so našli eno najstarejših lesenih koles na svetu. Približno koliko je staro?
gloss: One of the world's oldest wooden wheels was found on the Ljubljana Marshes. Roughly how old is it? — About 5,000 years (dated c. 3150 BC). The wheel was invented in the 4th millennium BC, which rules out 10,000.

text: Botaniki med jagode štejejo sočne plodove, kot sta grozdje in paradižnik. Kaj od naštetega je botanično jagoda?
gloss: Botanists count fleshy fruits such as grapes and tomatoes as berries. Which of these is botanically a berry? — The banana. The strawberry ('jagoda' in Slovene, the trap) is an accessory fruit, the raspberry an aggregate, the cherry a drupe.

text: Herman Potočnik Noordung je leta 1929 zasnoval vesoljsko postajo na tiru, kjer obkroži Zemljo natanko v enem dnevu. Kako danes imenujemo tak tir nad ekvatorjem?
gloss: In 1929 Herman Potočnik Noordung designed a space station on an orbit that circles Earth in exactly one day. What do we call such an orbit above the equator today? — Geostationary orbit.
